claims: Responds to the new concern, interested prospects who stopped replying, instead of the earlier duplicate-campaign steps.

question:
LATEST CUSTOMER MESSAGE (the one to work on):
I have show several with VERY HIGH INTEREST that  we have replied to but not hearing back from them

EARLIER TURNS (context only: they resolve what "it", "that" or a follow-up refers to while the subject is the same, and do not carry over once the latest message changes subject. Only recent messages are shown and some may be cut, so a detail missing here is not proof the customer never gave it):
Customer: two
Support: Glad I could help with that first one. Let me know what you would like to know about the other paused campaign whenever you are ready.
Customer: My Campaign Two has had the best results of them all.  I would love to duplicate everything that that campaign did to achieve that success going forward for now.  Can we do that?
Support: Yes, you can duplicate that successful campaign. Here is how to do it:
1. Open Cold Email Agent under Marketing.
2. Find the campaign you want to duplicate in the list.
3. Click the three-dot menu on the right side of that row.
4. Click Duplicate Campaign.
5. In the modal, enter a new campaign name with a minimum of 3 characters.
6. Click Duplicate.
Customer: OK I have clicked on duplicate campaign.  What happens now?
Support: 1. In the modal, enter a new campaign name with a minimum of 3 characters.
2. Click Duplicate.

The duplicate appears in your campaigns list within a few seconds and starts in Draft status without affecting the original.
Customer: I see that now
Support: Glad that helped! Let me know if you need help with anything else.
